name: Collateral Agreement
definition: Agreement between two trading parties that contains information about their relative duties and rights regarding collateral processes.

MarginConvention.name: Margin Convention
MarginConvention.definition: Determines how the variation margin requirement will be calculated, either net or gross.

CallFrequency.name: Call Frequency
CallFrequency.definition: Specifies the frequency at which collateral positions are evaluated and margin calls are issued.

AssociatedMasterAgreement.name: Associated Master Agreement
AssociatedMasterAgreement.definition: Agreement in which the parties agree to most of the terms that will govern collateral transactions.

StandingSettlementInstructions.name: Standing Settlement Instructions
StandingSettlementInstructions.definition: Settlement instructions which must be used for the settlement of collateral unless otherwise specified.

ExposureTerm.name: Exposure Term
ExposureTerm.definition: Specifies the terms used to calculate a risk exposure and its coverage.

Collateral.name: Collateral
Collateral.definition: Specifies the collateral which is the subject of the agreement.

RiskCoverage.name: Risk Coverage
RiskCoverage.definition: Collateral management process which applies the terms agreed in the collateral agreement.
